{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Build and CMake changes merely support compiling the new tool and test binaries.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Build modifications only follow from the addition of the new executable and test suites, not changes to the build system itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Design documents and release notes accompany code changes rather than forming a standalone documentation PR.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates are auxiliary to the implementation of the new private broadcast subsystem and tool."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches to node interfaces do not alter IPC transport mechanics or process separation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Interface modifications are routine adjustments to expose private broadcast methods rather than changes to the IPC architecture."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Incidental touch to chainparams does not alter the libbitcoinkernel API or library boundary.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not modify kernel interfaces or decouple validation from node state."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies package acceptance and relay handling in src/rpc/mempool.cpp and fixes package fee validation logic.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Adds 1-parent-1-child package support to private broadcast and fixes a package fee overflow bug. Commit ee5719d0c6 fixes a validation bug where prioritisetransaction deltas near INT64_MIN caused a modified fee sum overflow in package handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the 'Private Broadcast' label and rewrites P2P private broadcast connection, relay, and peer management logic in src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.88,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Eliminates severe deanonymization risks and timing oracles in transaction broadcasting. Relying on node state creates observable timing oracles, addrman manipulation vectors, and proxy bypasses (#35319/#35410, #36312, #36277), making an isolated broadcast engine critical for network privacy."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "RPC file edits simply expose the underlying broadcast engine methods rather than altering RPC transport or JSON-RPC infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to RPC files merely surface private broadcast capabilities and do not change RPC protocol behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Extensive unit, functional, and fuzz test additions specifically validate the private broadcast engine and tool.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The extensive test additions pin the behavior of the private broadcast feature rather than modifying core test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds the new standalone bitcoin-privbcast command-line utility in src/bitcoin-privbcast.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces bitcoin-privbcast as an isolated standalone tool for private transaction relay. It allows broadcasting over Tor SOCKS5 and BIP324 without requiring bitcoind node state."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Movement of BIP324 and transport code to libcommon serves P2P networking rather than generic utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Extracted transport code is specific to network communication and does not represent changes to general-purpose utility libraries."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Package fee handling adjustments in validation files relate to mempool package policy rather than consensus rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "The PR does not substantively change consensus validity rules or UTXO chainstate management."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
